answer: Incident: 34 identities idled nine epochs and kept full score. Change: score decays 6% per idle epoch, and each unverified claim subtracts a flat 12 points. Recruits are audited outside their sponsor line, so a crystal of accounts registered by one operator cannot grade one another. The vault keeps the decay history, which makes the recovery curve readable after the fact. Cost: a farm must produce verified work on every account or watch the score slide to the glacier line where payouts stop.
